name: 奉仕時間の編集
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
ONE Lighthouse component LH11-0011 奉仕時間の編集: only the two-by-two time/duration fields plus note, no page header or footer. Image1 ORIGINAL Jobber source controls glyph geometry, proportions, stroke, alignment, spacing and fine controls; Image2 Japanese mock is SECONDARY content/layout reference. Image3 approved bus is white surface/quiet depth style only. Restore original small clock-outline glyph in START time field that the mock omitted; do not invent any other icons.
Pure white #FFFFFF canvas, compact logical390x248 field group rendered high resolution. Five white rounded input controls with fine neutral borders, very subtle depth, disciplined gaps. Top row two equal fields: left label 「開始時刻」 value 「09:00」, with small original-style slate clock outline on the left, round face and two connected hands; right label 「終了時刻」 value 「10:30」. Second row two fields: label 「時間」 value 「1 時間」, and label 「分」 value 「30 分」. Full-width bottom note field label 「備考」 value 「受付と片付け」. Keep EXACT saved Japanese text/time/duration and values.09:00–10:30 equals1hour30minutes. Original source has other times; retain localized catalog data, not source English values.
Use original clock shape and optical proportions, about16logicalpx beside14px body, never a rough oversized clock. Fine rounded control shapes and consistent baselines based on original. Meiryo14/24 regular values,12/16regular labels, zero tracking; do not bold all values or add oversized headings. White controls, #1D1D1D ink, #6E6E6E labels, #526173 clock. No active selection/primary action exists in this isolated crop, so no forced green accents, gradient button, tint or status. The source green save/ellipsis footer and page close/title are OUTSIDE this component and must not be added. No fabricated controls, metrics, artwork, phone frame or app chrome. Calm compact raster design candidate only.
reviewNotes: 日本語/五欄/90分値/中立白を保持。原画時計はラベルと値の二行に対して左側中央だが生成は値だけの横でラベルが左へ戻り、原画の細部整列と異なる。時計と開始欄ラベル配置を要修正。未承認・未実装。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
